sound_command.description: Command to execute for sound notifications (e.g., 'aplay', 'paplay')

main_window_geometry.description: Main window geometry in WxH+X+Y format

show_tray_icon.description: Whether to show system tray icon when minimized

auto_connect.description: Whether to automatically reconnect to hubs on disconnect

hubs.description: List of configured hubs (dchub:// or adc(s):// URLs). Each entry must include at least 'address'.

user_list_visible.description: Whether user list panel is visible on startup

downloads_widget_visible.description: Whether downloads queue widget is visible on startup

search_widget_visible.description: Whether search widget is visible on startup

emoticons_enabled.description: Whether emoticons are enabled in chat

ipfilter_rules.description: List of IP filter rules. Format: CIDR::direction::action (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24::in::allow')
